wordmark.purpose: Header wordmark only. 'ACROSS' tracked to 0.03em, 'word' lowercase.

display.purpose: The clue line on the puzzle page (h1). Steps to 1.875rem at >=640px. text-wrap: pretty.

display-sm.purpose: Clue lines in archive rows and the How to Play demo. Steps to 1.1875rem at >=640px.

sort.purpose: Uppercase letters on the tiles. Steps to 2rem at >=640px.

sort-sm.purpose: Tiles in the How to Play demo.

title.purpose: Dialog titles and the 'Solved in N guesses' heading.

figure.purpose: Stat numbers in the Statistics dialog, tabular.

body-sm.purpose: Status line, secondary copy, archive intro.

caption.purpose: Countdown, demo captions, archive status, icon-button labels.

dateline.purpose: Uppercase 'DAY N · WEEKDAY, MON D' line directly under a clue. Never used above a heading.

guess-trail.purpose: Previous guesses as spaced type; correct letters in Spot Ink at 700.

themes.mechanism: All colors are custom properties on :root (light) and :root[data-theme="dark"] (dark) in styles/globals.css. An inline script in app/layout.tsx sets data-theme before paint from localStorage 'acrossword-theme', falling back to prefers-color-scheme.

shadows.name: pressed-edge
shadows.purpose: Foot of an empty or typed sort.

shadows.name: pressed-edge-spot
shadows.purpose: Foot of a locked or solved sort.

shadows.name: hairline
shadows.purpose: Every divider: header bottom, section tops, list rows, stat cells, dialog border. A border, not a shadow; listed because it is the system's depth device.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: All transitions and animations except the error shake. Settles without overshoot.

motion.name: duration-set
motion.purpose: Letter sets into a sort: scale 0.9 to 1.

motion.name: duration-color
motion.purpose: Color, border, and background changes on controls, slots, and sorts.

motion.name: duration-theme
motion.purpose: Body background/color on theme change; sort background; theme icon opacity.

motion.name: duration-enter
motion.purpose: Bottom sheet (translateY 24px), centered panel (translateY 8px), result fade-up (6px), nav rule slide.

motion.name: duration-lock
motion.purpose: Sort press on lock or solve (scale 1, 0.92, 1); theme icon rotate/scale.

motion.name: duration-close-up
motion.purpose: Found word opens its inner word space (0 to 0.26em) and inks from Ink to Spot Ink.

motion.name: duration-rule-draw
motion.purpose: Teal rule draws under the found word, scaleX 0 to 1 from the left, after a 260ms delay.

motion.name: stagger-solve
motion.purpose: Per-sort delay when the solved sorts press in sequence.

motion.name: delay-result
motion.purpose: Result block fade-up delay after solve.

breakpoints.name: wide
breakpoints.purpose: Measure 24rem to 28rem; clue, small clue, and sort letters step up; dialog becomes a centered panel.

icons.style: Inline SVG line icons, 24-unit viewBox, stroke-width 1.75 (2 for check marks), round caps and joins, currentColor.

components.css: .ds-clue { font-family: 'Libre Franklin', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1.625rem; line-height: 1.3; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: -0.012em; color: var(--ink); margin: 0; } .ds-found { position: relative; color: var(--spot-ink); font-weight: 700; animation: ds-ink-in 360ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1) both; } .ds-found::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: -0.06em; height: 0.08em; background: var(--spot); border-radius: 1px; transform-origin: left center; animation: ds-rule-draw 560ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1) 260ms both; } .ds-found-space { display: inline-block; width: 0.26em; animation: ds-space-open 360ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1) both; } @keyframes ds-rule-draw { from { transform: scaleX(0); } to { transform: scaleX(1); } } @keyframes ds-space-open { from { width: 0; } to { width: 0.26em; } } @keyframes ds-ink-in { from { color: var(--ink); } to { color: var(--spot-ink); } }

components.css: .ds-bar { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule); background: var(--paper); } .ds-bar-in { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; max-width: calc(24rem + 2rem); margin: 0 auto; padding: 0 1rem; height: 3.5rem; } .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; margin-right: -0.625rem; } .ds-home { margin-left: -0.625rem; text-decoration: none; } .ds-icon-btn { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-width: 2.75rem; height: 2.75rem; padding: 0 0.625rem; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: var(--ink-2); cursor: pointer; transition: color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1), background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1), transform 120ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1); } .ds-icon-btn:hover { color: var(--ink); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 6%, transparent); } .ds-icon-btn:active { transform: scale(0.94); } .ds-icon-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--spot); outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: 6px; } .ds-wordmark { font-family: 'DM Serif Display', Georgia, serif; font-weight: 400; font-size: 1.375rem; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: 0.005em; color: var(--ink); } .ds-wordmark b { font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0.03em; } .ds-nav-rule { position: absolute; left: 0.625rem; right: 0.625rem; bottom: -0.375rem; height: 2px; background: var(--ink); } .ds-divider { width: 1px; height: 20px; background: var(--rule); margin: 0 0.25rem; }

narrative.overview:
The page is a printer's composing stick. The clue is one line of set type with a five-letter gap in it, and the player's letters are type sorts that drop into that gap. Nothing sits behind the line: no background art, no card, no app chrome beyond a hairline-ruled top bar. Everything that is not the clue exists to help fill it, check it, or share it.

The world is cool white stock and near-black ink, with one spot ink: the brand teal. Teal means "this letter is right". It prints locked letters, the found word, and the correct cells of a result. Depth comes from hairline rules and the pressed edge along the bottom of each sort, never from shadows, glass, or gradients. The layout is dense and single-column, sized for one thumb on a 390px phone, and the desktop view is the same column centered on a wider measure.

Motion is typesetting motion. Sorts set in with a small scale-up, press in when they lock, and shake sideways on a wrong guess. On solve, the gap closes into the finished sentence: the real word space opens inside the answer, the letters ink from black to teal, and a teal rule draws under the hidden word from left to right. Every move eases out and settles. Nothing bounces.
keyCharacteristics: One line of type is the hero; the gap in the clue mirrors the tiles as the player types.
Cool neutral paper, near-black ink, and a single teal spot ink used for correct letters.
Hairline 1px rules for structure; the only other depth is a 2px pressed inset edge on the sorts.
Libre Franklin for everything, DM Serif Display for the wordmark only, tabular figures for every changing number.
Light and dark themes share one set of token names and swap values under `data-theme="dark"`.

rules.name: The One Spot Ink Rule
rules.body: Teal means a letter is right. It fills locked and solved sorts, colors correct letters in type, and draws the found-word rule; beyond that it appears only as the system focus ring, caret, and selection wash. Buttons, links, headings, icons, and chart bars stay in ink.

rules.name: The Cool Stock Rule
rules.body: The paper is cool neutral (`#f6f7f7`), never cream or warm. Raised surfaces are plain white (`#ffffff`) in light mode and a single lighter step (`#1b1e21`) in dark mode.

rules.name: The Paired Theme Rule
rules.body: Every color is a named custom property on `:root`, redefined under `:root[data-theme="dark"]`. Components use the property, never a raw hex, so both themes come from one component definition.

rules.name: The Wordmark-Only Serif Rule
rules.body: DM Serif Display sets the wordmark and nothing else. Headings, numbers, and buttons are Libre Franklin.

rules.name: The Figures Line Up Rule
rules.body: Any number that changes (day number, countdown, stats, guess counts, version) uses `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums` so digits do not shift.

rules.name: The Dateline Follows Rule
rules.body: The tracked-caps dateline sits under the clue it dates and carries real data. It is not a label placed above headings.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Dividers are 1px `rule` lines. Borders on controls are 1.5px. The two heavier marks are deliberate: the 2px ink rule under the current nav item and the rule under the found word, which is 0.08em thick.

rules.name: The No Lift Rule
rules.body: Nothing floats. No drop shadows, glass, blur, gradients, or background shapes. A dialog is a sheet of raised stock over a scrim.

dos: **Do** keep the clue as the largest type on the page (26px, 30px at 640px and up) and let the gap sit inside the sentence.
**Do** use Spot Teal and Spot Ink only for letters that are right, plus the focus ring, caret, and selection wash.
**Do** separate regions with 1px `rule` hairlines and spacing, not boxes or shadows.
**Do** keep primary actions full width, 52px tall, in Ink, directly under the stick.
**Do** give every interactive control a hit area of at least 44px.
**Do** set every changing number in tabular figures.
**Do** use the ease-out curve `cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1)`, keep durations between 120ms and 560ms, and honor reduced motion.
**Do** define every new color as a custom property with both a light and a `data-theme="dark"` value.
donts: **Don't** use DM Serif Display anywhere but the wordmark.
**Don't** add drop shadows, glass or blur, gradients, or background blobs. The only shadow is the 2px inset pressed edge on sorts.
**Don't** warm the paper toward cream or add a second accent hue.
**Don't** color buttons, links, headings, icons, or chart bars teal.
**Don't** round sorts past 6px or turn them into pills or circles.
**Don't** let any motion overshoot or bounce; scale moves go down and return to 1.
**Don't** put tracked-caps labels above headings; the dateline sits under the clue it dates.
